judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports hit all four expectations with nearly identical citations and reasoning; Report 2 is marginally more precise on the shadow-scoring fix mechanics, but overall the two are comparable in coverage and quality.

report_1.evidence: ENABLE_DEBUG_TOOLBAR = "true" ... Delete the key entirely from the prod file. ... PRESET_ADMIN_ACCOUNTS = "qa@example.com:superadmin" ... Delete the key entirely. ... SHADOW_SCORING_SINK ... Delete both keys from the prod file ... LEGACY_BILLING_SECRET_ARN ... delete the key

report_2.evidence: ENABLE_DEBUG_TOOLBAR = "true". ... Change to "false" or delete the key. ... PRESET_ADMIN_ACCOUNTS = "qa@example.com:superadmin". ... Remove the entry (set to empty) ... SHADOW_SCORING_SINK ... Either set it to "" ... LEGACY_BILLING_SECRET_ARN ... This needs a production-specific secret ARN

report_1.evidence: Because the URL is inlined at build time, there is no runtime fix — production needs its own build (`.env.production` with the prod API URL, a `--mode production` build, a separately pushed image/digest), not a promotion of the staging artifact.

report_2.evidence: production users would load a frontend hard-wired to call `https://staging-api.example.com`, not the production API. ... one of the two has to change (per-environment builds, or runtime-injected API base URL).

report_1.evidence: the workflow contains no migration step at all ... For a first production release the prod database schema does not exist; the three migrations ... need an explicit first pass, manual or pipelined. "The pipeline succeeded" would not mean the schema exists.

report_2.evidence: the workflow has no migration step ... The first release must bring a fresh production database from nothing through `0001_base`, `0002_tenants`, and `0003_billing` ... as things stand nothing will do that.
But `infra/prod/main.tf:3` — unedited from the staging copy — trusts `repo:acme-health/medislot:environment:staging`. ... Change to "repo:acme-health/medislot:environment:production"
